title: Full and injured HP bar native submission after Ram

verification.actor: One current WILD Onix (species 95) at map 33 tile (585,412), with the player at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Teleport directly to Route 29, spawn and bind Onix five tiles south, read the full bar, then let its natural Ram hit once.
verification.observable: Native bar submission has fill 44 at 100 HP and fill 30 at 67 HP after one real Ram.

setupMutations.change: Use the checked Route 29 teleport, native Wild Onix spawn, and exact live identity bind. Do not change HP, Ram policy, or bar state.
No state mutation; the player stands still while Onix chooses its normal Ram.

limits: Prepared Onix placement tests real Ram contact and HP damage, not natural population spawn selection.
The full native bar receipt is read after the same direct teleport and spawn used by the Ram/rest test.
Native OAM submission and resource selection are measured; final LCD pixels, color appearance, and hardware application are not proven.
START-menu suppression/rebind and amber danger warning need separate live samples; this scenario does not claim them.
Missing Onix, wrong HP or fill, battle, or an incomplete native receipt fails.

events.value: Place and bind Onix five tiles south of the player, then read the full native bar.
Observe normal Ram damage and proportional native bar fill.

stop.condition: Full and injured native submission are checked after one Ram, or the first invalid HP, actor, or field observation.

invariants: One current Wild Onix owns Ram damage
